bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'USERBOT_SERVICE_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'USERBOT_SERVICE_ENABLED='; systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'GSERVER_G_DRIVE_MOUNT='; if mountpoint -q /mnt/g; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'GSERVER_STORAGE_DIRECTORY='; if test -d /mnt/g/GserverStorage; then echo YES; else echo NO; fi
printf 'PROJECT_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'PROJECT_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'USERBOT_IPC_MODULE='; if test -f scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py;then echo YES;else echo NO;fi
